fit: Compare old32 fit on regular/fronted contexts with new32 and new64 fit on regular/fronted plus regular/relative-clause contexts. All irregular nouns excluded from fitting. Freeze bases before interventions. Within each span compare Euclidean projection and target-informed float64 response oracle, rcond=1e-10.
identity: Context-switch response T(dc,e)=Down(Left(dc)*Right(e)+Left(e)*Right(dc)). Quadratic-in-e term cancels exactly.
design: Evaluate all irregular fronted and relative-clause rows at both signed doses. Old32 versus new32 holds dimension fixed; new32 versus new64 holds discovery coverage fixed. Full and unchanged references. No outcome-based selection or new prompt claims.
scope: Oracle sees each full local response target and actual incoming perturbation. It minimizes local Euclidean response error only, not output KL or answer loss; success is not generalization. Counterfactual coefficient norms and conditioning are reported.
